purpose: Reduce the 162-cell sparsity of the frozen five-axis regime layer without choosing historically attractive combinations. Report every marginal state and every unordered two-axis joint state symmetrically as a state-versus-complement contrast on unchanged DON8, EMA8 and VOL8 trades.

inherits.v1_1_inference_context_only: The corrected v1.1 result motivated reducing dimensionality because of sparsity, but no axis, pair, state or direction is selected from v1.1 PnL.

hierarchy.interpretation: Pairwise joint states are secondary conditional descriptions and are never allowed to appear without the complete lower-order marginal family.

contrast_definition.marginal_pool: all trades with a known label for the selected axis
contrast_definition.marginal_complement: all other known states of the same axis
contrast_definition.pairwise_pool: all trades with known labels for both selected axes
contrast_definition.pairwise_complement: all other state combinations of those two axes

bootstrap.null_hypothesis: group and complement have equal mean net_bps
bootstrap.null_imposition: center group and complement separately to their pooled mean before applying the shared block draws

multiplicity.global_family: all eligible predeclared marginal and pairwise contrasts within strategy

literature_basis.source: Bien, Taylor and Tibshirani (2013), A lasso for hierarchical interactions
literature_basis.note: Interaction analysis should retain lower-order structure rather than allowing isolated high-order combinations to drive interpretation.

literature_basis.source: Politis and Romano (1994), The Stationary Bootstrap
literature_basis.note: Dependence-aware resampling motivates shared calendar-block draws; this protocol keeps the repository's fixed 30-day nonoverlapping block convention rather than claiming to implement the stationary bootstrap algorithm.
BH FDR is reported as a power-oriented reference.
BY FDR is also reported because the 92 overlapping state hypotheses are strongly dependent.
Global Holm FWER is the conservative reference for same-period descriptive discoveries.
Recent evidence documents condition-dependent cross-correlations among major cryptocurrencies, supporting market coupling as a descriptive state axis without validating any trading filter.
